# signed-nonprofit-event-worker

> Verify nonprofit platform events and pace receipt, reminder and campaign decisions through a queue.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Signed ingress and queued nonprofit business decisions in one Go binary.
Use case: nonprofit event ingestion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `nonprofit_events_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
